description.zh: 群组成员。可通过[ListChatGroupParticipants](~~2932628~~)接口获取群组成员。
description.en: The participant number of the group member. You can obtain the participant numbers of group members by calling the [ListChatGroupParticipants](~~2932628~~) operation.

descriptions.zh:
><notice>通过API删除IM群成员功能属于Meta内测功能，请联系您的商务经理申请加白。></notice>

- 在调用此接口之前，请确保您创建成功的IM群已添加IM群邀请链接且已有成员通过链接进入IM群。

- 若您没有已创建成功的IM群，可通过[AddChatGroup](~~2998429~~)、[AddChatGroupInviteLink](~~3019211~~)接口创建并添加IM群邀请链接。

- 删除IM群成员后，该成员将不再接收IM群的任何消息，请谨慎操作。
descriptions.en:
><notice>

This operation is a beta feature from Meta. Contact your account manager to add your account to the allowlist before use.

></notice>

- This operation requires an existing IM group that members have joined via an invitation link.

- To create an IM group and add an invitation link, call the [AddChatGroup](~~2998429~~) and [AddChatGroupInviteLink](~~3019211~~) operations.

- Removed members no longer receive messages from the group. Use this operation with caution.
